AddMsConfigAttributes.description_en: Adds a property to a configuration item in a configuration file. You can push a property only after it is added
AddMsConfigAttributes.description_zh: 在配置文件配置项中增加属性，只有添加属性之后，才能对属性进行推送

AddMsConfigResources.description_en: Adds resource metadata. A resource is similar to a file and can have multiple attributes
AddMsConfigResources.description_zh: 资源相当于文件的概念，一个资源下可以有多个属性

CreateMqSofamqGroup.description_en: Creates a Group ID. The created Group ID is used to publish and subscribe to messages
CreateMqSofamqGroup.description_zh: 创建 Group ID。创建的 Group ID 用于发布和订阅消息

CreateMqSofamqTopic.description_en: Specifies the message type and topic name to create a topic
CreateMqSofamqTopic.description_zh: 需要指定消息类型与 Topic 名称

DeleteMqSofamqTopic.description_en: Deletes a specified topic. After the topic is deleted, all subscriptions under the topic are cleared
DeleteMqSofamqTopic.description_zh: 删除后，该 Topic 下所有的订阅关系会被清理

DeleteMqSofamqTrace.description_en: Deletes a specified message trace query task
DeleteMqSofamqTrace.description_zh: 删除指定的消息轨迹查询任务

DeleteMqSofamqWarn.description_en: Deletes a specified alert rule by alert rule ID

DeleteMsConfigAttributes.description_en: Deletes the metadata of a property based on the property ID. Deleting the property metadata does not delete the property values
DeleteMsConfigAttributes.description_zh: 根据属性 ID 删除对应的属性元信息。删除属性元信息，属性值不会删除

DeleteMsConfigResources.description_en: Delete the corresponding resource by resource ID. Deleting a resource will also delete all attribute information under the resource
DeleteMsConfigResources.description_zh: 根据资源 ID 删除对应资源，删除资源会同时删除对应资源下所有的属性信息

DisableMqSofamqWarn.description_en: Disables a specified alert rule by alert rule ID
DisableMqSofamqWarn.description_zh: 通过传入报警规则 ID，禁用指定的报警规则

EnableMqSofamqWarn.description_en: Enables a specified alert rule by alert rule ID
EnableMqSofamqWarn.description_zh: 通过传入报警规则 ID，启用指定的报警规则

GetMqSofamqConsumerJStack.description_en: Queries consumer call stack information for troubleshooting purposes

GetMqSofamqConsumerStatus.description_en: Includes subscription consistency checks, consumption TPS statistics, load balancing status, and consumer connections
GetMqSofamqConsumerStatus.description_zh: 包含订阅关系检查、消费 TPS 统计、负载均衡状态、消费端连接等

GetMqSofamqDLQMessageById.description_en: Queries a dead-letter message by Message ID
GetMqSofamqDLQMessageById.description_zh: 精确查询，根据 Message ID，查询死信消息

GetMqSofamqMessageById.description_en: Queries a message by exact match. The Message ID required for the query is obtained from the SendResult returned each time a message is sent successfully
GetMqSofamqMessageById.description_zh: 精确查询。查询条件需要的 Message ID 从每次消息发送成功的 SendResult 中获取

GetMqSofamqTraceByMsgId.description_en: Queries the delivery trace of a message by Message ID
GetMqSofamqTraceByMsgId.description_zh: 根据 Message ID 查询消息的投递轨迹信息

GetMqSofamqTraceResult.description_en: Retrieves the details of a message trace query result by specifying the query task ID
GetMqSofamqTraceResult.description_zh: 过传入查询任务 ID，获取对应的轨迹查询的结果明细

GetMsConfigAttributes.description_en: Get the corresponding attribute information by attribute ID
GetMsConfigAttributes.description_zh: 根据属性 ID 获取对应的属性信息

GetMsConfigResources.description_en: Retrieves the metadata of a resource by resource ID
GetMsConfigResources.description_zh: 根据资源 ID 获取资源元信息

GrayPushMsConfigData.description_en: Pushes a property value by IP-based canary release
GrayPushMsConfigData.description_zh: 按 IP 灰度推送属性值

ListMqSofamqGroup.description_en: Queries the list of Group ID resources in a specified environment instance
ListMqSofamqGroup.description_zh: 查询指定环境实例下 Group ID 资源的信息列表

ListMqSofamqTopic.description_en: Queries the list of topics for a specified instance
ListMqSofamqTopic.description_zh: 查询指定实例下 Topic 的信息列表

ListMqSofamqTrace.description_en: Queries the list of message trace query tasks under a specified instance
ListMqSofamqTrace.description_zh: 查询指定实例下的消息轨迹查询任务列表信息

ListMqSofamqWarn.description_en: Obtain the list of alarm rules
ListMqSofamqWarn.description_zh: 获取报警规则列表信息

ListMqSofamqWarnHistory.description_en: Query historical alert records. By default, alert information within the last 30 days is retained
ListMqSofamqWarnHistory.description_zh: 查询历史报警记录，目前默认保存 30 天以内的报警信息

PushMsConfigData.description_en: Pushes a property value. After the push, all clients that subscribe to the corresponding property update the in-memory value within one second and invoke the setter method associated with the property
PushMsConfigData.description_zh: 推送后所有订阅对应属性的客户端都会在一秒内更新内存值，并回调属性对应的 setter 方法

QueryMqSofamqConsumerAccumulate.description_en: Provides a rough assessment of message consumption and latency
QueryMqSofamqConsumerAccumulate.description_zh: 用于粗略判断消息消费情况和延迟情况

QueryMqSofamqConsumerConnection.description_en: Determines whether the consumer of a specified Group ID is online and retrieves the detailed list of client connections
QueryMqSofamqConsumerConnection.description_zh: 判断指定 Group ID 的消费者是否在线，并获取详细的客户端连接的列表

QueryMqSofamqConsumerTimespan.description_en: Queries the earliest and latest message timestamps currently stored on the server for a specified topic, as well as the most recent consumption time of the consumer
QueryMqSofamqConsumerTimespan.description_zh: 可以查询某个 Topic 当前服务器上存在的消息的最新时间和最早时间，以及查询消费端最近消费的时间

QueryMqSofamqDLQMessageByGroupId.description_en: Queries all dead-letter messages within a specified Group ID during a specified time range by paging
QueryMqSofamqDLQMessageByGroupId.description_zh: 分页查询指定时间段内 Group ID 内的所有死信消息

QueryMqSofamqGroupSubDetail.description_en: Queries the subscription information of a group. If the consumer instances corresponding to the Group ID are not online, no data is returned
QueryMqSofamqGroupSubDetail.description_zh: 如果 Group ID 对应的消费者实例不在线，则查不到数据

QueryMqSofamqMessageByKey.description_en: Performs a fuzzy query. Because the Message Key of a business may not be unique, the query result may contain multiple messages
QueryMqSofamqMessageByKey.description_zh: 模糊查询。由于业务方的 Message Key 可能不唯一，所以查询结果可能为多条

QueryMqSofamqMessageByTopic.description_en: Queries all messages within a specified topic during a specified time range by paging. You can pass in the topic name and time range for the query
QueryMqSofamqMessageByTopic.description_zh: 通过传入 Topic 名称和时间段，分页查询指定时间段内 Topic 内的所有消息

QueryMsConfigAttributes.description_en: Retrieves detailed property information, including the property ID, based on the domain, application name, resource ID, and property name. Other API operations depend on this operation to obtain the property ID
QueryMsConfigAttributes.description_zh: 根据域,、应用名、资源 ID、属性名称获取属性详细信息，包含属性 ID。其它接口都依赖此接口获取属性 ID

QueryMsConfigClientValues.description_en: Queries the memory value of a specified client by property ID
QueryMsConfigClientValues.description_zh: 根据属性 ID 查询指定客户端的内存值

QueryMsConfigClients.description_en: Queries the information about all clients that subscribe to a property. When a dynamic configuration client starts, it establishes a persistent connection with the server and reports its associated property information. You can use this persistent connection to query the information about all clients that subscribe to the property
QueryMsConfigClients.description_zh: 查询一个属性所有订阅的客户端信息。动态配置客户端在启动的时候，会与服务端建立长连接，并告知动态配置服务端自身关联的属性信息，通过此长连接可以查询到所有订阅属性的客户端信息

QueryMsConfigData.description_en: Queries the last pushed value of a property by property ID
QueryMsConfigData.description_zh: 根据属性 ID 查询其最后一次推送值

QueryMsConfigResources.description_en: Queries resource metadata by fuzzy matching an application name or resource ID
QueryMsConfigResources.description_zh: 根据应用名或者资源 ID 模糊查询对应的资源元信息

QueryRMSMetrics.description_en: Queries monitoring metrics timing data based on conditional query filters such as metric ID
QueryRMSMetrics.description_zh: 根据指标ID等过滤条件查询监控指标时序数据

QueryRMSUnifiedAlarmNotifyHistory.description_en: Query alarm notification history, including notification records from DingTalk, phone calls, SMS, and webhooks, as well as notification status
QueryRMSUnifiedAlarmNotifyHistory.description_zh: 查询告警通知历史，如钉钉、电话、短信、webhook的通知记录，以及通知状态

ResendMqSofamqDLQMessageBatch.description_en: Resends dead-letter messages with specified message IDs in batches so that consumers can consume these messages again
ResendMqSofamqDLQMessageBatch.description_zh: 批量重发指定 Message ID 的死信消息，使这些消息能够被 Consumer 再次消费

ResendMqSofamqDLQMessageById.description_en: Resurrects a dead-letter message so that the message can be consumed by a consumer again
ResendMqSofamqDLQMessageById.description_zh: 使死信消息复活，让消息能够被 Consumer 再消费一次

ResetMqSofamqConsumerOffset.description_en: Resets the consumer offset of a specified Group ID to a specified timestamp. This operation is typically used to clear accumulated messages or replay consumed messages
ResetMqSofamqConsumerOffset.description_zh: 重置指定的 Group ID 的消费位点到指定时间戳。一般用于清理堆积消息，或者回溯消费

UpdateMqSofamqGroupRemark.description_en: Modifies or updates the description of a group
UpdateMqSofamqGroupRemark.description_zh: 修改或更新 Group 的描述信息

UpdateMqSofamqTopicRemark.description_en: Updates the description of a topic
UpdateMqSofamqTopicRemark.description_zh: 用来更新或修改 Topic 的描述信息

UpdateMqSofamqWarn.description_en: Updates the configuration of the specified alert rule
UpdateMqSofamqWarn.description_zh: 更新指定报警规则的配置信息

UpdateMsConfigAttributes.description_en: Updates the metadata of a property by property ID
UpdateMsConfigAttributes.description_zh: 根据属性 ID 更新属性元信息

UpdateMsConfigResources.description_en: When update_attribute is set to false, only the resource metadata is updated, and the property information is not updated
UpdateMsConfigResources.description_zh: update_attribute 为 false 时，则只更新资源元信息，不会更新属性信息
